|game_text=Deploy on table. While you have more systems on table than opponent, your capital starships may deploy at -2 (to a maximum of -3) to battlegrounds. When you deploy an [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V){{!}}Imperial-class Star Destroyer]], may deploy (for free) a [Death Star II] or [A New Hope] squadron there (no replacement necessary) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 2 of 4 known). The image here, the release-sheet slip, prints it. The current text is [[Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4), which has these words again.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-dreadedimperialstarfleet-pre.gif]]), slip 22E, in the V-kit copy by 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-1240_23">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/blob/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips/virtual9-dark/dreadedimperialstarfleet.png V-kit slip image virtual9-dark/dreadedimperialstarfleet.png] (Lee Edwards' V-kit, svn r1, committed 9 December 2009; copy on GitHub). It is the same image as the Players Committee card image.</ref>: “Deploy on table. While you have more systems on table than opponent, your capital starships may deploy at -2 (to a maximum of -3) to battlegrounds. When you deploy an Imperial-Class Star Destroyer, may deploy (for free) a [Death Star II] or [A New Hope] squadron there (no replacement necessary) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” This is the 9 September 2009 errata (ruling H1, Bill, 10 November 2026); the card list later stamps this wording "(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)". The image is dated by the V-kit copy, not by its later server upload (25 February 2013). The September 2009 first printing is lost, so it has no page. '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; slip number “22E” bottom right, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 4 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 22E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 3, slip 22E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. While you have more systems on table than opponent, your capital starships may deploy at -2 (to a maximum of -3) to battlegrounds. When you deploy an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, may deploy (for free) a [Death Star II] or [A New Hope] squadron there (no replacement necessary) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-22E-Dreaded_Imperial_Starfleet.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; slip number “22E” bottom right, the Virtual Block 4 set mark. '''What changed:''' “Imperial-Class” is written “Imperial-class”, with a small c.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (V) (Errata 3)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 4 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1240_23">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on table. While you have more systems on table than opponent, your capital starships may deploy at -2 (to a maximum of -3) to battlegrounds. When you deploy an Imperial-Class Star Destroyer, may deploy (for free) a [Death Star II] or [A New Hope] squadron there (no replacement necessary) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Imperial-class” is written “Imperial-Class” again, with a capital C: the same words as PC-E1. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). No published image shows the card-list text, so the image of [[Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (V) (Errata 3)]] is a CardMaker recreation. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.

(Immune to Alter.)” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-23-master.png]]) prints it. '''What changed:''' “Imperial-Class” is written “Imperial-class” again, with a small c: the same words as the release sheet (PC-E2). It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Document:''' Master List slip; only “E” bottom right where the release-sheet slip prints “22E”, the Virtual Block 4 set mark.
